prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
Private study booth inside a quiet study café, late evening after work. The setting is intimate and still — a personal desk carved into a semi-enclosed wooden partition. Floor-to-ceiling window to one side reveals a blurred city night skyline, bokeh streetlights and building glow bleeding softly into the room.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No product. A ceramic mug of black coffee sits at the right edge of frame, steam barely visible, placed directly on the raw oak desk surface beside a half-open notebook with a pen resting across it.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
Only hands and forearms visible — a person wearing a chunky ribbed knit sweater in oatmeal-cream wool, sleeves pushed slightly up, fingers resting naturally on a laptop keyboard mid-thought. No face, no torso, no identifiable features. Hands relaxed, natural skin texture, no posed stiffness.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Raw oak desk surface with faint grain texture. A slim mechanical pencil beside the notebook. Soft glow from a small warm-toned desk lamp just out of frame at upper left. Wooden booth partition wall visible at the right edge, warm-stained. City bokeh through the window — amber, gold, and cool blue pinpoints of light layered in the background.

[LIGHTING]
45° camera-left from the window, motivated practical light from city glow and desk lamp combined, 3200K tungsten desk lamp warmth blended with 7000K+ blue-hour city window spill creating a split 3800K mixed ambient tone. Soft falloff with gradient transition across the knit fabric. Contact shadow only at base of mug. Deep shadow side at right edge of desk with selective fill.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 85mm portrait, aperture f/2.0, shallow depth of field with focus on the knit-covered forearms and keyboard, mug and city window softly defocused into bokeh layers behind.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Quiet and introspective. The after-work exhale — tired but focused. Warm indoor stillness against cold city night outside. Slightly hazy air from steam and ambient humidity.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Oatmeal cream and warm amber as dominant tones. Deep charcoal-blue from the window bokeh as counterpoint. Low-contrast, muted, film-adjacent palette with lifted shadows.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, Pia Ulin. Editorial commercial photography.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic knit fabric texture with individual yarn detail, natural hand skin with visible knuckle texture and subtle vein detail, authentic steam behavior above mug, true bokeh rendering on city window lights.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible text, no letters, no numbers, no typography anywhere in frame, no words on notebook, no screen text visible on laptop.

resolution: 2k
